title: India to Host BWF World Championships 2026, Mascot Competition Launched
indian_angle: India is set to host the prestigious BWF World Championships in 2026, marking a significant milestone for Indian badminton and engaging the public through a mascot competition.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced a mascot competition for the upcoming BWF World Championships 2026, which India will host, signaling preparations for the major international event.

title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships Kicks Off in Guwahati
indian_angle: Indian junior players are undergoing intensive training at a national camp in Guwahati, preparing to represent the country at the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has commenced at the National Center of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, bringing together India's top junior talent.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) conducted an advanced coaching course in Guwahati and Raipur, aiming to enhance the skill sets of Indian badminton coaches.
summary: The BAI Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course was successfully conducted at the NCE Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, focusing on advanced coaching techniques.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Changed for World Junior Championships Selection Trials
indian_angle: A change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 highlights the dynamic nature of India's junior team preparations.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) announced a change in the Women’s Doubles Pair for the Selection Trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttlers are attending a coaching camp in Guwahati to prepare for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026, aiming for strong performances.
summary: An Indian Team Coaching Camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 was held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: The implementation of the 3x15 scoring system in domestic junior tournaments by BAI signifies a strategic move to adapt and develop Indian badminton talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has implemented the 3x15 scoring system in Domestic Ranking Tournaments and National Championships for U-13, U-15 & U-17 age groups.
